visual_goal: Show the appraisal service composing vehicle facts, condition, valuation and policy into MPP lines, then handing an accepted offer to the dossier and the register stock-in.
prompt: A left-to-right hub illustration. Far left: a phone showing a checklist, labeled 'Appraise app'. One arrow from 'Appraise app' into a large central box labeled 'Appraisal service', the arrow labeled 'sync outbox'. Above the central box, three source boxes in a row, each with one arrow pointing down into 'Appraisal service': a box with a car silhouette and a document labeled 'Vehicle context', a clipboard box labeled 'Condition', and a gauge box labeled 'Vantage'. Below the central box, two boxes side by side: on the lower left a rulebook box labeled 'Buying policy' with one arrow up into 'Appraisal service'; on the lower right a calculator box labeled 'MPP calculator' with one two-way vertical arrow to 'Appraisal service'. Directly to the right of the central box, one long arrow leaves the right edge of 'Appraisal service' itself, labeled 'offer accepted', and goes into a folder box labeled 'Dossier'. One arrow from 'Dossier' into a document box with a blank round stamp, labeled 'Register stock-in'. The stamp carries no text. These are the only labels in the image.
alt: An appraise app syncs to the appraisal service, which draws on vehicle context, condition, Vantage and the buying policy, uses an MPP calculator, and hands an accepted offer to the dossier, which starts the register stock-in.

visual_goal: Show an offer's lifecycle: issued offers never change; revisions supersede; acceptance leads to purchase only after the handover check.
prompt: A simple state map of seven rounded tiles. Far left: grey 'Draft'. Center left: blue 'Issued'. Above 'Issued': grey 'Superseded'. Below 'Issued': orange 'Expired'. Center right: teal 'Accepted'. Below 'Accepted': orange 'Re-inspection'. Far right: green 'Purchased'. Exactly seven arrows: one from 'Draft' to 'Issued' labeled 'committed'; one from 'Issued' up to 'Superseded' labeled 'revised'; one from 'Issued' down to 'Expired' labeled 'days or distance'; one from 'Issued' to 'Accepted' labeled 'seller accepts'; one from 'Accepted' down to 'Re-inspection' labeled 'check fails'; one curved arrow from 'Re-inspection' back to 'Issued' labeled 'new version'; one from 'Accepted' to 'Purchased' labeled 'handover'. A small padlock icon inside 'Issued'.
alt: Offer states: Draft is committed to Issued; Issued is superseded by a revision, expires on days or distance, or is accepted; Accepted goes to Purchased at handover, or to Re-inspection when the check fails, which issues a new version.

visual_goal: Show the Golf Variant appraisal from scan to stock: odometer and valuation in, MPP lines out, a revised offer as a new version, and one hand-off to the dossier.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with four equally spaced vertical lanes, each with a thin vertical lifeline running down from its header. Lane headers, each an icon and a label: a phone labeled 'Appraise app', a server labeled 'Appraisal service', a gauge labeled 'Vantage', and a folder labeled 'Dossier'. Each horizontal arrow starts exactly on one lifeline and ends exactly on another lifeline. Arrows, top to bottom: from the 'Appraise app' lifeline to the 'Appraisal service' lifeline labeled '61,240 km'; from 'Appraisal service' to 'Vantage' labeled 'value'; from 'Vantage' back to 'Appraisal service' labeled '€23,750'; from 'Appraisal service' back to 'Appraise app' labeled 'MPP €19,434'; from 'Appraise app' to 'Appraisal service' labeled 'offer v2 €19,250'; from 'Appraise app' to 'Appraisal service' labeled 'accepted'; from 'Appraisal service' to 'Dossier' labeled 'stock item created'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: Swimlanes for the appraise app, appraisal service, Vantage and dossier: 61,240 km in, €23,750 valuation, MPP €19,434, offer v2 at €19,250, acceptance, and a stock item created in the dossier.
